description: Per-character finisher wiring: damage IDs for solo and tag-team super attacks, multi-hit behavior, linked domain expansion and the character-specific super-attack ranking record.

Id.simple: Character ID used as the row key.
Id.technical: Unreal DataTable row name. ResolveDataRows resolves it from CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterSpecialAttack, with FStudioBattleCharacterOverrides::SpecialAttackIdOverride taking priority when set. The row is required; failure aborts character row resolution. Asset collectors and battle phases independently look up the same row by the character's Id_CharacterSpecialAttack.

Id_GlossaryText_Name.simple: Name-text ID field on the special-attack row; no direct use was found.
Id_GlossaryText_Name.technical: FName serialized on every exported row, with all 42 exported values set to None. No consumer of SpecialAttackRow.Id_GlossaryText_Name exists in the available Source/Plugins. The numerous Id_GlossaryText_Name hits belong to the distinct CharacterDataTable field (row +0x10) and must not be attributed here.

Id_Damage_SpecialTagCombo.simple: Damage row used for the tag-team special combo finisher.
Id_Damage_SpecialTagCombo.technical: FName key into DamageDataTables. State 6 reads it from Performers[0] both for lethal-damage prediction (IsLethalSequenceDamage with bIgnoreStock=false) and for the actual ApplySequenceDamage on the target after the sequence. ApplySequenceDamage resolves the Damage row and sends a multi-hit request with flags 0x23.

Id_Damage_SoloSpecialAttack.simple: Damage row used for the solo super-attack finisher.
Id_Damage_SoloSpecialAttack.technical: FName key into DamageDataTables. State 5 reads the finisher's value to predict lethality (with bIgnoreStock=true) while accumulating team costs, and applies it once per knocked-out character at sequence end. Missing damage rows make the lethal check return false and the damage request carry a null DamageRow.

bMultiHitSoloSpecialAttack.simple: Whether the solo super hits every listed victim instead of one chosen target.
bMultiHitSoloSpecialAttack.technical: Bool. AGameCharacter::IsMultiHitSoloSpecialAttackEnabled returns this field unchecked via interface slot 168. The battle knockout collector uses it: when true, all alive victims become KnockedOut and the search breaks; when false, it narrows to one victim by secondary/target selection. Constructor default false; exported CP_020 is the sole true row among 42.

Id_DomainExpansion.simple: Domain-expansion row tied to the character's super.
Id_DomainExpansion.technical: FName key into DomainExpansionDataTables. ResolveDataRows resolves it optionally into DomainExpansionRow; battle assets and GamePhase_BattleBase use it to reach DomainExpansion.Id_Map and preload that map's MiniMapFileName. State 7 uses it to select the domain-transformation area transform, falling back to the tag-combo transform when the row or Id_Map is absent. None is allowed and means no domain link.

RankingRecord.simple: Which numbered super-attack ranking record this character can earn.
RankingRecord.technical: EGameRankingRecord enum. EvaluateRankingRecords compares the player's SpecialAttackRow->RankingRecord against each RankingRecordDataTable row for the numbered SuperCursedEnergyAttack_01..27 records; on a match and a SuperCursedEnergyAttack_Hit battle-log threshold it appends the enum byte to earned records. Constructor default None; 14 exported rows are None.

notes: The exported table has 42 rows; available Content is partial, so this is not a claim about every retail character or Blueprint reference.
Id_GlossaryText_Name on this row is distinct from CharacterDataTable.Id_GlossaryText_Name; no direct consumer of the special-attack copy was identifiable. All exported values are None.
Source evidence is reconstructed C++; locations with retail RVAs in comments are provenance hints, not a byte-match verdict.

usages.detail: Resolves the required SpecialAttack row from CharacterDataTable.Id_CharacterSpecialAttack, honoring the studio override, and caches it in SpecialAttackRow.
Uses Id_Damage_SoloSpecialAttack to decide whether each knocked-out opponent constitutes a team defeat.
Applies Id_Damage_SoloSpecialAttack to every loser at the end of the solo super sequence.
Uses Id_Damage_SpecialTagCombo for lethal prediction before applying tag-combo damage.
Applies Id_Damage_SpecialTagCombo from the first performer to the target.
Exposes bMultiHitSoloSpecialAttack through IGameActorInterface for the knockout collector.
Branches knockout collection to all victims when multi-hit solo special is enabled.
Resolves Id_DomainExpansion to choose the domain-expansion transform versus the tag-combo fallback.
Joins SpecialAttack -> DomainExpansion -> Map to collect the domain map's minimap texture.
Matches the character's RankingRecord against earned numbered super-attack ranking records.
